lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular spot clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. These spots are organized into approximately five vertical rows with relatively uniform spacing between neighboring centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like anchor system on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a vertical pixel intensity gradient showing highlights on the superior edge and slight shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced caustic light patterns from surface refraction are visible as high-intensity, irregular wavy lines overlaid across the anterior portion of the shark's flank.
